constraints.N: actual strict metadata-frozen eligible speaker count, never hardcoded12; acquisition may not silently shrink it
constraints.source_original_split: must equal full original_split_required including corpus and pinned archive revision
constraints.source_split_directory: must equal split_directory_required; never use it as the full namespace
constraints.archive_member_path: StreamCorrect/aishell1_testset/<exact selected source_id>.wav, exactly the frozen catalog member
constraints.reference: read only after metadata selection frozen; never used to accept/reject/swap a source
constraints.integrity: actual complete WAV bytes match exact frozen original ZIP member CRC/length; WAV and PCM SHA recorded; exact historical collision stops rather than selects another clip
constraints.technical_failure: same-member network/CRC retry only; CRC-valid header/band failure can advance only the frozen same-speaker list; exhaustion STOP, no silent N/speaker/split substitution
constraints.self_hash: receipt SHA is recorded externally in data GATE/driver plan; a data_freeze_sha256 field must name a separate immutable DATA_MANIFEST, never self-reference
